submittedParameters.prompt: Edit reference1 into ONE independent transparent full-canvas NORTH run animation frame. Reference2 is established style only. EXACT same head, hair, camera, framing, upper torso scale, costume, hand poses, bow in anatomical LEFT hand at screen-left, empty RIGHT hand screen-right, right shoulder quiver. Change ONLY specified lower-leg/foot anatomy and tiny natural hip weight shift, never whole-image translation or scale. Her running direction is AWAY from viewer toward screen top. Ground contacts progress in depth along that direction, never sideways toe yaw. Straight foot alignment means knee/ankle/foot aim forward; preserve soft natural knees, not rigid locked joints. Keep entire costume, green/gold/ivory boot designs, fixed canvas margins. No background, drawn floor, shadows, labels or effects. Make these narrow anatomical corrections, leave head/body/hair/scale EXACTLY unchanged. Anatomical LEFT foot screen-left is the sole SUPPORT foot. The LEFT support boot is currently too close to its knee. Unfold that left knee/shin anatomically a little and extend its projected reach DOWN by about45 pixels on1024 canvas to a grounded heel edge near y900. Keep original boot dimensions and a flat planted heel/forefoot, upright green heelcup, no underside. This is later in the SAME anterior ground position than05 and before07. The anatomical RIGHT leg screen-right is swinging behind and its current boot hangs too low. Flex the RIGHT knee much more, bring RIGHT heel back/up close toward buttocks; its green sole faces viewer but boot bottom MUST be CLEARLY HIGHER than the supporting LEFT sole, approximately normalized y0.79 (y810 on1024). Keep natural leg length and single coherent knee/ankle. Restore anti-phase arm swing for LEFT leg support: LEFT bow arm swings BACK toward viewer, LEFT hand lower beside waist aroundy550 in1024, gripping complete long bow; RIGHT empty fist swings FORWARD away from viewer and UP near shoulder at y485 in1024, with elbow bent. Never put bow in right hand. Bow arm and empty arm counter-swing, no spread-eagle. Original boot design exactly one small gold diamond at upper cuff, plain ivory shaft, gold rim. No additional ornaments or gem at ankle. Do not copy a previous pose, this must be distinct second anterior contact.
